title: routing_announce: test_callback_failure_allows_same_seq_retry fails at HEAD (native_sim)
description: Pre-existing failure, discovered while verifying b7z9.8.2.1 (which only touched router.c parse_ipv6_dispatch - announce ingest does not call it). On native_sim/native/64 (Zephyr 4.1.0 workspace, worker1 checkout @ 5080c04904+): lichen/tests/routing_announce main.c:431 lichen_announce_ingest_authenticated(announce, len, NULL) is expected non-zero (callback-failure path) but returns 0, so the same-seq retry path is not exercised as asserted. 8/9 other tests pass. Repro: west build -b native_sim/native/64 lichen/tests/routing_announce -t run. Likely cause: ingest no longer fails when the auth callback pointer is NULL (guard removed or inverted in announce.c) - needs triage; the test or the code may be wrong.
